prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate pain in the right shoulder with limited range of motion, particularly with overhead reaching and internal rotation. Examination revealed tenderness over the anterior joint line, painful arc of motion, and positive impingement signs. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture or dislocation, with findings consistent with a partial-thickness soft tissue strain of the rotator cuff.

Over a course of 13 visits, the patient was managed with a structured physical therapy program focused on restoring scapular stability, progressive range of motion, and graded strengthening. Modalities including ultrasound and ice were used early in care, transitioning to active rehabilitation as pain decreased. Home exercise instruction was reinforced at each visit.

By the final visit, the patient demonstrated substantial improvement in pain levels and shoulder mobility, with near-full active range of motion and improved strength. Residual mild discomfort with heavy lifting remains. The patient has been advised to continue the home program and to return if symptoms worsen. Discharge from active treatment is recommended with a plan for follow-up as needed.
